The collision anticipated before the pull — electronics retailers — did not appear, because every row Ahrefs returned contains the word 'music'; the actual competition for the phrase is a festival calendar. So the page cannot be justified on this seed's volume, and should not be. It earns its traffic through the named genres it covers, each of which has its own map and its own guide, and this file exists to record that the head phrase was measured and is nearly empty rather than leaving the next person to spend units finding out.
